# Noor Al-Sabeel (نور السبيل)

> Free, open-source Android app for prayer times (salah), the full adhan and the qibla compass — no ads, no tracking, and all calculations run offline on the device.

Noor Al-Sabeel is developed by AhmedZakeFit and released under Apache-2.0. Prayer times support twelve calculation methods (Umm al-Qura, Muslim World League, Egyptian General Authority of Survey, ISNA, Karachi, Gulf, Kuwait, Qatar, Singapore, Turkey, France, or custom angles), with a ±30-minute shift on any individual time to match a local mosque. The app plays a complete recorded adhan at prayer time (with a separate Fajr adhan), shows a pre-prayer reminder with a live countdown, includes a qibla compass with magnetic-declination correction, and displays the official Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar (1924–2076). It collects nothing and sends nothing to any server; the network is used only for the optional online city search and the in-app update check. The app UI is available in Arabic and English. It is not on Google Play; distribution is a direct signed APK from GitHub Releases, and an F-Droid submission is planned but not guaranteed.

## Pages

- [Landing page (Arabic)](https://ahmedzakefit.github.io/noor-al-sabeel/): overview, features, install steps and FAQ in Arabic.
- [Landing page (English)](https://ahmedzakefit.github.io/noor-al-sabeel/en/): the same page in English.

## Download and source

- [Direct APK download (latest stable, signed)](https://github.com/AhmedZakeFit/noor-al-sabeel/releases/latest/download/noor-al-sabeel.apk): always resolves to the newest verified release.
- [Source code](https://github.com/AhmedZakeFit/noor-al-sabeel): Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, Apache-2.0.
- [Releases and checksums](https://github.com/AhmedZakeFit/noor-al-sabeel/releases): versioned APKs with SHA-256 checksums.
